name: Custom Purge
description: Lightweight, queueable and customizable cache purging.
project_description: Custom Purge is a lightweight, plugin-based cache purging module for Drupal. It adds an admin form to purge individual URLs from configured caching instances and Drush commands to enqueue purges of whole caches. It is a major refactor (fork) of BurdaMagazinOrg/module-custom_purge with a new, non-backwards-compatible config schema and a queue-based approach controlled by the delay_complete_purge config key. Purge targets are modeled as PurgePlugin plugins; the module ships three: Drupal's internal page cache, Varnish and Cloudflare. Configuration is keyed by named profiles (one active per environment) and per-domain settings; there is no settings UI, so custom_purge.settings must be edited/imported as YAML. Requires Drush 9/10/11 and a regular cron run (or scheduled drush queue:run calls) to process the custom_purge_urls and custom_purge_everything queues.
